query:
SELECT b.id, u.name as student_name, u.email as student_email, u.phone as student_phone, 
       p.name as program_name, b.sessionDate, b.sessionStartTime, b.sessionEndTime, 
       b.status, b.notes, b.totalAmountCents
FROM bookings b
JOIN user u ON b.userId = u.id
JOIN programs p ON b.programId = p.id
WHERE b.sessionDate = CURDATE()
ORDER BY b.sessionStartTime ASC;
